question.title: Frequently Asked Questions
question.text: Find answers to the most common questions from our clients and partners. If you can't find what you're looking for, our support team is always here to help.

items.question: What services do you provide?
items.answer: We specialize in website development, web applications, custom software solutions, UI/UX design, and IT consulting services.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: The project timeline depends on its complexity and requirements. After the initial consultation, we provide a detailed schedule.

items.question: Do you provide support after project delivery?
items.answer: Yes. All projects include a technical support period, and long-term maintenance plans are also available.

items.question: How is the project cost calculated?
items.answer: Pricing is based on the required features, development time, and overall project complexity. We always provide transparent quotations.

items.question: Do you develop custom software?
items.answer: Yes. We build fully customized software solutions tailored to your business needs and goals.

items.question: Which technologies do you use?
items.answer: Our team works with modern technologies such as React, Node.js, TypeScript, Laravel, Python, and modern database systems.

items.question: Do you work remotely?
items.answer: Yes. Our entire workflow—including planning, design, development, and support—can be completed remotely.

items.question: How can I request a project?
items.answer: You can submit your project request through our contact form, email, or the contact numbers available on our website.

items.question: Do you offer UI/UX design services?
items.answer: Yes. Our UI/UX services include user research, wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design.

items.question: Can you upgrade existing software?
items.answer: Yes. We provide software modernization, redesign, optimization, and feature enhancement services for existing applications.

story.paragraph1: Our journey began in 2024 with a vision to provide innovative and comprehensive technology solutions. From the very beginning, our goal has been more than delivering products or services—we believe technology creates real value when it simplifies processes, improves efficiency, and empowers businesses to grow.

After a thorough analysis, we handle design, development, implementation, testing, and support according to modern industry standards. Quality, innovation, commitment, and continuous support are the values that define our work and build long-term partnerships with our clients.

items.title: Sales Management Dashboard
items.description: An advanced dashboard for analyzing and managing sales with real-time statistics, revenue charts, order management, customers, and products.
items.about: This project was developed to help businesses monitor sales performance and manage customers, products, and orders more efficiently. It provides real-time analytics, interactive charts, and a fully responsive interface for administrators.

items.title: Online Cosmetics Store
items.description: A complete e-commerce website with product listing, categories, search, and shopping cart.
items.about: This online store was designed to provide a fast and seamless shopping experience. Users can browse products, search, filter by category or brand, and complete purchases through a modern shopping cart system.

items.title: Restaurant Management Panel
items.description: A complete restaurant management system for orders, menus, and table reservations.
items.about: This management panel simplifies restaurant operations by allowing administrators to manage menus, customer orders, table reservations, and sales reports through a modern dashboard.

items.title: Corporate Website
items.description: A modern corporate website for showcasing services, team members, and portfolio.
items.about: This corporate website was built to introduce company services, projects, and team members. It features a clean design, responsive layout, and an engaging user experience.

items.title: Weather Application
items.description: A weather application that displays real-time weather data using an API.
items.about: This application fetches live weather information from the OpenWeather API and displays current temperature, humidity, wind speed, and multi-day forecasts with a responsive interface.

items.title: Task & Project Manager
items.description: A task management application for creating, editing, and tracking daily tasks.
items.about: This project helps users organize daily tasks efficiently. Users can create, edit, delete, and categorize tasks while storing data locally with LocalStorage and managing state using Zustand.

items.title: Programming Blog
items.description: A modern blog platform for publishing programming tutorials and articles.
items.about: This programming blog allows users to browse categorized articles, search content, and read detailed tutorials with SEO optimization and Markdown support.

items.title: Online Service Booking System
items.description: An online platform for scheduling appointments and booking services.
items.about: This system allows users to book services online by selecting their preferred date and time, submitting booking requests, and tracking reservation status through a personal dashboard. Secure user authentication is implemented to ensure data privacy and account security.
